title: Thank you Andy!!
text: We originally booked this tour and requested a food tour. There were 5 adults and 2 kids in our group from Seattle. Our tour guide ended up being Andy. We were given a meeting location outside our hotel and he was given a different location so we started about 20 minutes late. Once we were connected and told Andy we weren't really hungry due to the time change we had just eaten. Andy quickly pivoted and we had a city tour instead. title: food tour
text:
we had a terrific experience with our tour guide Elvira. She took us for reasonably priced delicious tapas 
She was able to describe many traditional meals to us and make the experience wonderful it was good for my family kids and adult adults both. The tour was tailored to our preferences.

title: Amazing Culture and Food Experience!
text: Elvira was amazing! We've been on several tours here and learnt the most from her. She tailored the tour to our interest and needs, and were very patient with my active 6 and 3yr olds. At the end of the tour, she shared a list of recommended restaurants, which immediately became useful in the evening. Thank you!

title: Great for families

title: E-biking Barcelona
text: Elvira, a native of Barcelona, is a wonderful and informative guide.  The E-bike tour is a great way to see many parts of Barcelona in a short amount of time to help decide which you may want to spend more time exploring.  The pick up/drop off at our cruise ship port was a great convenience!  Highly recommend this tour and Elvira!
author: Anne_C
